Racks/Core/DesktopIconManager.cs.why: Creates and styles the RacksWorkspace folder (Racks' own folder), its hidden icon and desktop.ini, and writes the library file. Never touches a user file. Shell gateway work is P3.

Racks/RackWindow.DragDrop.cs.why: CreateDirectory of the VirtualFrames root and of a new rack sandbox under %AppData%\Racks: Racks-owned state, created empty, never a user folder.

Racks/Util/CrashLog.cs.why: Appends to and rotates the app's own logs (crash.log, audit.log) under AppData. Not user data.

Racks/Util/JunctionHelper.cs.why: Creates the junction directory and removes it again on failure, plus its debug log. Operates on directories Racks just created.

Racks/Infrastructure/Layout/LayoutFileWr.why: Atomic layout export and recovery file: (1) new FileStream(CreateNew) writes the bytes to a hidden random temp file in the destination folder (never overwrites), (2) one File.Move(temp, destination, overwrite: true) puts it in place whether or not the destination exists (File.Replace is not used: it can fail half way with the old file gone), (3) File.Delete removes the writer's own temp file, only when the destination is confirmed unchanged. Replaces the old single File.WriteAllText (P9); the path goes through PathPolicy.ValidateFullPath first.

Racks/Infrastructure/Layout/RecoveryFold.why: The recovery copy of the user's racks after a failed layout import (%AppData%\Racks\recovery, Racks-owned): Directory.CreateDirectory of that folder, and File.Delete of recovery files older than the newest 5 (name pattern layout-*.json, same folder only). The file itself is written by LayoutFileWriter.

Racks/Util/RackMirror.cs.why: CreateDirectory of the mirror root %USERPROFILE%\Racks (Racks' own folder, created empty; the junctions inside go through FileOperationBroker.Unlink).

Racks/Util/ShortcutFactory.cs.why: Copies a dropped .url file into the rack under a unique name: File.Copy never overwrites and the source is left where it was. A copy, not a move or a delete.

Racks/Util/UninstallCleanup.cs.why: Only Racks' own files and folders in the uninstall process: its report, the kept-files note, desktop.ini and the icon, the Quick Access library file, and CreateDirectory of the workspace and of a missing Desktop. All moves, unlinks and folder removals of user data go through the broker (INV-UNINSTALL-1).

Racks/Infrastructure/Update/InstallerExe.why: The installer download: new FileStream(CreateNew, FileShare.None) creates the one file of a fresh, random, owner-only folder (Racks-update-<guid> in %TEMP%) and writes at most the signed size into it. Never a user file; never overwrites. Moved from Util/Updater.cs in P10.

Racks/Infrastructure/Update/UpdateCleanu.why: Deletes the files and then the folder of Racks' own per-run download folder (exact name Racks-update-<32 hex>, no reparse points, no sub-folders, not younger than 10 minutes). Not user data. Moved from Util/Updater.cs in P10.
